say:2:1524633001:0.text: Where... am I? I remember cooking some mushroom soup. It smelled amazing! After a few sips, everything went fuzzy...
say:2:1524633001:0.source_cn: 我……我这是在哪？我记得，我炖了蘑菇汤，可香可香，喝完...

say:3:1524633002:0.text: Still licking your lips over that soup? You picked poisonous mushrooms and knocked out your entire family!
say:3:1524633002:0.source_cn: 还在这回味汤呢！你捡了毒蘑菇，把一整家人都给毒倒了！

say:4:1524633003:1.text: If he hadn't been here to help, I doubt I could've made enough antidote for everyone!

say:7:1524633006:1.text: Count yourself lucky those mushrooms weren't the deadly kind! Otherwise, no antidote could've saved you!
